subject: general
question: Two people drive towards each other from two places which are 56 km apart. The speed of the first person is 13 km/h and speed of the other is 14 km/h. After how long will they be 2 km apart if they start driving together?
solution:
**Given:**

Distance between two places = 56 km

Speed of the first person = 13 km/h

Speed of the second person = 14 km/h

**Formula Used:**

Relative speed when two objects move towards each other = Sum of their speeds

Time = Distance / Relative Speed

**Calculation:**

Relative speed = 13 km/h + 14 km/h = 27 km/h

Distance to be covered to be 2 km apart = 56 km - 2 km = 54 km

Time taken to cover 54 km:

⇒ Time = 54 km / 27 km/h

⇒ Time = 2 hours

**The time after which they will be 2 km apart is 2 hours.**
